source_evidence: Exact player 'Lets rest and return to the watchtower tomorrow, then to the seat' accepts complimentary overnight manor hospitality, return to tower to exercise existing signed handover, and states intention to subsequently seek ancestral seat. Day334~20:38 to D335 morning: complimentary guest rooms, existing guarded manor lodging; predeclared wilderness-weight 1 unit rather than secure friendly estate (no general immunity or established secure-household classification). Uninterrupted qualifying overnight SR, LR3→4/6. No missing HP/Psi, no HD, Second Wind or Psi Recovery expenditure, no LR-only recovery. All resources remain as before. Routine standing Tamsin dawn communication, no invented reply. No new accommodation cost or extra provisions added. Independent NPC chronology: D335~04:07 existing yard Guard arrives western customs tower after actual uninterrupted12 rough miles/8h, delivers Caul's previously signed unconditional release order to Voss. Voss reads/accepts as valid, orders existing tower guard to release the two actual detained adults AR-D1/AR-D2 from cellar immediately. Both alive, able to walk; released without payment/oath, leave custody voluntarily and freely at early morning; no new prisoner count, injury, restitution or transfer of property, no bounty assumed. Existing patrol had already returned and temporary collection suspension obeyed D334. Manor courier stays at tower to rest after journey; no return trip or new report assumed. Tower retainers remain originally4 plus road patrol3, plus visiting manor courier; no new hire or forced service. Caul remains at manor, trial agreed in principle and implementation/results pending; no new offscreen financial or program outcome invented. D335~07:30 departure from manor, ordinary twelve rough miles/8h return route, predeclared remote day occurrence01–40, single-day leg cap1, reused regional table. Actual Python secrets receipt batch981eead06e7f677030d9835bfd178c45 d10092 quiet, no further type/severity. Arrive tower~15:30, healthy coach/four horses, all companions full HP. Charge D335 full-day consumption once, rations3→0 and horse feed4→0. No automatic new supplies or purchases. Voss reports actual released prisoners and returned patrol to party, sees actual original signed relinquishment directive already held by V, willingly implements peaceful administrative/physical handover of western customs station, gives V the existing keys, preserves records/facilities/equipment in place. V now takes practical possession/control pursuant to Caul's relinquishment; no Crown title, parcel boundary, toll franchise, arbitrary additional assets, third-party goods or confiscated-property ownership conveyed. No formal registration or asset count/appraisal yet. Voss understands unlawful dues permanently terminated under handover; existing levy claims no longer enforced on this road; actual broader restitution/accounting and permanent independent safe-passage verification pending, no payment/quest reward assumed. Voss recommended as potential steward but no appointment, wage or employment agreement yet. Seven tower retainers remain existing Caul employees pending freely chosen disposition; visiting manor courier not a tower asset. Voss offers to coordinate transition and asks whether V wishes to retain him and any personnel, and notes actual supplies must be obtained before further travel. V chooses terms and provisioning, then ancestral-seat expedition; current seat route still needs fixed prepared geography using Silverward WNW bearing, historical aqueduct/cistern/twin gatehouses sketch, no exact site or travel time invented. No additional travel, roll, resources, personal spending, restitution, legal title or new hiring. D335~15:35. Important milestone full estate/owner-ledger sync remains pending; accepted recovery records exact.
